title: How to donate books in Kolkata · AquaTerra
description: How to donate books in Kolkata: AquaTerra's Book Basket collections gather books for underprivileged children, with {count:book-basket} drives in all.
lede: You can donate books in Kolkata through AquaTerra's Book Basket collections, which gather books for underprivileged children, and through the Wear and Write drives, which collected notebooks alongside clothes. Book Basket began in March 2022 and returned in June and July 2025, with {count:book-basket} drives in all.

sections.heading: the Book Basket drives
body: Book Basket 1.0 was a collection in Kolkata in March 2022, and its drive notes 20 kgs of books. The series came back in 2025 with drives at housing complexes such as Dreamland Housing, Paymanti Housing, Emami City, South City Residency and Santosh Apartments. The 2025 drives ran close together. Between 2 June and 8 July 2025, Book Basket drives were held in Ballygunge, Ideal Gardens, Natural City in Laketown, Beleghata, Bidhanagar Tank and Saltlake, among other places.

sections.heading: who the books are for
body: Each Book Basket drive gives its purpose in a line: books for underprivileged kids, gathered with help from volunteers. The drive that opened the 2025 run describes a book collection to fill shelves and minds with stories. Most drives were measured in kilograms. The drive at Ashoka Building in July 2025 notes three kilograms of books, and the one at Bidhanagar Tank in June 2025 notes five.

sections.heading: notebooks with clothes
body: Wear and Write is the drive where notebooks come in with clothes. Its campaigns ran from April 2024 to May 2025 at places such as Active Acres, Anandam Apartment and Sweta Apartment in Bangur, Salarpuria Pearl in Gopalpur and Kolkata. The campaign's own line is that it collects and distributes clothes and notebooks to support children's basic needs and education.

sections.heading: how to hand in books
body: Each drive is written up on the [projects page](/projects) with its date and place. For the next collection near you, write through the [contact page](/contact). If you want to run a collection of your own, the [how to run a book donation drive](/impact/how-to-run-a-book-donation-drive) guide sets out how AquaTerra's student teams ran theirs. One drive's blurb puts the idea simply: your old books can write someone else's new story.

learnings: The 2025 Book Basket run moved from one housing complex to the next across June and July, so a collection can be repeated at each new site.
Notebooks were collected alongside clothes in Wear and Write, so one drive can take both.
The series began in 2022 and was repeated in 2025, so the same kind of collection has run in two different years.
Most Book Basket drives note their haul in kilograms, which makes the size of one collection easy to compare with another.

faqs.q: Where can I donate books in Kolkata?
faqs.a: Give books to an AquaTerra Book Basket collection. Book Basket has run {count:book-basket} drives, in March 2022 and then across June and July 2025, at housing complexes and neighbourhoods such as Ballygunge, Salt Lake and Bidhanagar Tank.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra collect books for children?
faqs.a: Yes. Book Basket drives collect books for underprivileged children, and Book Basket 1.0 in March 2022 noted 20 kgs of books collected.

faqs.q: Can I donate notebooks to AquaTerra?
faqs.a: Yes. Wear and Write campaigns collected notebooks along with clothes in 2024 and 2025. AquaTerra's drives are run by student volunteers aged fourteen to nineteen.

faqs.q: Can I donate money for books instead?
faqs.a: AquaTerra takes no monetary donations and charges no fees. Book collections are donations of books, and AquaTerra's welfare work is paid for through its own student-run events and through Crftd, its student streetwear label.

faqs.q: How do I run a book donation drive in Kolkata?
faqs.a: Use the how to run a book donation drive guide, which sets out how AquaTerra's student teams ran their collections at housing complexes and neighbourhoods.
